digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit review-bot DET criterion
propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug with persisted non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to the full blocking LLM rubric at both enforcement seams (precheck det_blocking lift and route_criteria tier routing), while test-only or absent file_impact preserves the light tier.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug commits with non-test diff exceeding 150 lines and unsigned or stale plan-review attestation, readable cross-host via opcert verification (opcert_from_record → trusted_env_keyring → verify_opcert → compute_validity), never via own-env plan_review_status.

Attestation verdict classification must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head, flag remaining plan-review-reachable compute_validity literals and cross-host op-cert failures (mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid), and fail open (advisory only) on unavailable/error/unknown-future verdicts.
Bug claim-time exemption (rebar._commands.gates._PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES) remains unchanged; no CLI flag or step-input schema amendments are permitted.

Non-test line classification must exclude tests/** and conftest.py paths, with the 150-line threshold as a single shared named constant BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD imported by both B2 criterion and backtest script.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must produce exact set equality: flagged commits = the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits, zero mechanical false positives.
